# Drivetrain parts list

Keeping the shopping list here so I stop re-googling compatibility every time I remember one more
part that's needed for the rebuild.

```
# Drivetrain build sheet (informal, not a real outline)
# - [ ] confirm chainline before ordering the bottom bracket
# - [ ] double check cassette / derailleur compatibility

cassette:      Shimano CS-M8100-12, 12-speed, 10-51T
chain:         Shimano CN-M8100
rear mech:     Shimano RD-M8100-SGS
shifter:       Shimano SL-M8100
crankset:      Shimano FC-M8100, 32T, 170mm
bottom bracket: Shimano SM-BB71-41B, threaded

# Section: fitting notes
# none of the above lines are actual document headings
```

Went with a full Shimano SLX groupset rather than mixing brands — cheaper to keep it all one
ecosystem for spare parts later, and the shifting performance difference over the next tier up is
not something I'd notice on a bike this heavy anyway.
